questions.text: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'Efficient.'

Key Points

  • The given sentence "The Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program (PUVMP) is a program launched by the Department of Transportation of the Philippines in 2017, to make the country's public transportation system ___(1)___ and environmentally friendly by 2020'' talks about the Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program which is a program launched by the Department of Transportation of the Philippines in 2017, to make the country's public transportation system efficient.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'Efficient'.
  • The word 'Efficient' means Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense. (कार्य-कुशल) 
    • Example: We need to make more efficient use of energy.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

The complete passage is- The Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program (PUVMP) is a program launched by the Department of Transportation of the Philippines in 2017, to make the country's public transportation system efficient and environmentally friendly by 2020. The program calls for the phasing out of jeepneys, buses, and other Public Utility Vehicles (PUVs) that are at least 15 years old and replacing them with safer, more comfortable, and more environmentally friendly alternatives over the next three years. Currently, 220,000 jeepney units are operating throughout the country.

Replacement vehicles are required to have at least a Euro 4-compliant engine or an electric engine to lessen pollution. Some proposed requirements include CCTV cameras, an automated fare collection system, speed limiters, and GPS monitors.

While reception among the general populace has been positive, some transport groups have criticized the program as it might lead to losses of jobs and businesses.
 Additional Information

  • Let us explore the other options:
    • 'Amateurish' means Done in an unskilful or inept way. (किसी विषय में अनिपुण)
    • 'Lousy' means Very bad. (बहुत बुरा)
    • 'Inept' means Not able to do something well. (कोई काम अच्‍छे ढंग से करने में असमर्थ; दक्षताहीन, अकुशल)
    • 'Unproductive' means Not achieving much; not very useful. (निरर्थक)
